name: robots/emb-ai__robobenchmart
title: RoboBenchMart MoveFromBoardToBoardVanishContEnv (fake stand-in)
intro: RoboBenchMart MoveFromBoardToBoardVanishContEnv (fake stand-in), adapted from emb-ai/robobenchmart. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
